name: autofix-gestion
description: Sistema de planificación, seguimiento y gestión del cambio de AutoFix

scripts.test:bd: docker compose exec -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://autofix:autofix@db:5432/autofix_pruebas api pnpm --filter @autofix/api test:bd
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @autofix/api db:migrate
scripts.db:deploy: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @autofix/api db:deploy
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @autofix/api db:reset
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @autofix/api db:seed
scripts.caso:xlsx: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @autofix/api caso:xlsx
